findings.body: `ExternalSttProvider::new` now contains `let endpoint: String = endpoint.into();` and sets `endpoint: endpoint.clone()` on the struct, but the function signature does not include an `endpoint` parameter. This results in an undefined variable compile error, preventing the crate from building. The constructor must be updated to accept an `endpoint: impl Into<String>` argument (or the usage of `endpoint` must be removed).
findings.existing_code:
let endpoint: String = endpoint.into();
            endpoint: endpoint.clone(),
findings.title: Add missing `endpoint` parameter to constructor

value.summary: The change introduces a compilation error because the `ExternalSttProvider::new` constructor does not accept an `endpoint` argument yet the body references an undefined `endpoint` variable.
